Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

future — the time after now. Example: In the future cities will be bigger.
plan — an idea about what you will do. Example: I have got a plan for next week.
goal — something you want to achieve. Example: My goal this year is to learn English.
dream — something you really want to do. Example: My dream is to open a café.
walk — to move on foot. Example: I walk every day.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Next month I am going to ...
• Next year I ...
• In five years I want to ...
• My goal is ...
• Thank you for listening.
